snippet.title: Sweetie's Motel — Trailer
snippet.description:
A free co-op horror game for 1-4 players about exploring an endless motel, running from scary things, and collecting room service trays.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5553140/Sweeties_Motel/
Website: https://sweetiesmotel.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/hxMbaybUCJ

From the studio behind KEEP IT ON HER.
